summary: Every hull now lays its trail by distance instead of a frame-bound timer, so trail mass no longer depends on frame rate; at 60 fps hulls lay 0-20% more at cruise and up to 1.75x at top speed (the timer dropped prisms), and only hulls past 600 u/s (Thresher, Rhino) stretch, at the Manta's limits.
why: The timer laid half the trail at 30 fps on Thresher, Rhino, Manta and Serpent; any mass balancing was measured against a frame-rate-dependent number.
